descNote: ⚠️ desc/descEn 是 AI 代拟的初稿（每条都标了 descDraft: true），只依据编曲/乐器/节奏/公认情绪基调写的一句话，不涉及站主的私人感受——这是个人站，别人代写的感受不该冒充成站主自己的。站主应该把它们换成自己的话，写法和保留机制见 docs/如何加歌.md。

tracks.title: 七里香
tracks.desc: R&B 底子的抒情流行曲，木吉他分解和弦托着慵懒的哼唱，副歌层层叠出清爽的夏日感。
tracks.descEn: An R&B-tinged pop ballad — arpeggiated acoustic guitar under a laid-back vocal, building into a breezy, summery chorus.

tracks.title: Hold on (feat. Dyslm & Dnakm)
tracks.desc: 低保真基调的都市流行曲，绵软的合成音色配松弛的节拍，适合放着不太用管它。
tracks.descEn: Lo-fi-leaning urban pop with soft synth textures and a loose, unhurried beat — built for drifting in the background.

tracks.title: Not For Me
tracks.desc: 钢琴与木吉他撑起的清唱式民谣，编曲克制，人声几乎不加修饰地贴着旋律走。
tracks.descEn: A stripped-back folk ballad carried by piano and acoustic guitar, the vocal left almost unadorned against the melody.

tracks.title: 晴天
tracks.desc: 木吉他分解和弦为主的抒情流行曲，节奏平稳，旋律带着温热的怀旧感。
tracks.descEn: A pop ballad built on steady arpeggiated guitar, its even tempo carrying a warm, nostalgic melody.

tracks.query: 我是一只小小鸟 - 赵传
tracks.title: 我是一只小小鸟
tracks.album: 当我们年轻的时候 / 新歌+经典现场录音专辑
tracks.desc: 摇滚编制的抒情曲，主歌克制、副歌用力嘶吼推上去，是典型的九十年代华语摇滚起伏结构。
tracks.descEn: A rock ballad that holds back in the verses and lets the chorus erupt into full-throated belting — a classic 90s Mandopop rock arc.

tracks.title: 稻香
tracks.desc: 明亮的民谣流行曲，木吉他扫弦配口哨旋律，中速节奏，情绪始终是轻快的。
tracks.descEn: A bright folk-pop tune with strummed acoustic guitar and a whistled motif — mid-tempo and unwaveringly cheerful.

tracks.title: All For You
tracks.desc: 钢琴起句、逐渐加进整个乐队的抒情曲，假声在副歌处拔高，动态从安静铺到饱满。
tracks.descEn: Opens on solo piano and swells into a full band, the falsetto lifting in the chorus as the arrangement builds from quiet to anthemic.

tracks.title: 我相信
tracks.desc: 励志向的摇滚抒情曲，弦乐铺底、乐队渐次加入，人声音域宽，副歌是明显的情绪高点。
tracks.descEn: A motivational rock ballad with strings underneath and the band building in, the wide vocal range peaking hard at the chorus.

tracks.title: 告白气球
tracks.desc: 轻快的流行曲，拨弦弦乐与探戈式的节奏重音，编曲俏皮，情绪是甜的。
tracks.descEn: A buoyant pop song with pizzicato strings and tango-flavored rhythmic accents — a playful arrangement with a sweet mood throughout.

tracks.query: 爱的初体验 - 张震岳
tracks.title: 爱的初体验
tracks.desc: 中速的民谣摇滚，木吉他弹唱式的编曲，人声像说话一样随性，节奏松弛不赶。
tracks.descEn: A mid-tempo folk-rock number, its strummed-guitar arrangement and conversational vocal keeping the groove unhurried.

tracks.query: 走慢一点点 - 张震岳
tracks.title: 走慢一点点
tracks.desc: 慢速的民谣曲，木吉他指弹为主，人声压得很低，整体节奏刻意放慢、不着急。
tracks.descEn: A slow folk tune led by fingerpicked acoustic guitar, the vocal kept low and the tempo deliberately unhurried.

tracks.query: 等我有一天 - 张震岳
tracks.title: 等我有一天
tracks.desc: 编曲从简单逐渐加入弦乐的慢板抒情曲，情绪克制而绵长，节奏走得很有耐心。
tracks.descEn: A slow ballad that grows from a spare arrangement into strings, its restrained mood unfolding at a patient pace.

tracks.query: 爱要怎么说出口 - 赵传
tracks.title: 爱要怎么说出口
tracks.album: 当我们年轻的时候 / 新歌+经典现场录音专辑
tracks.desc: 经典的九十年代摇滚抒情曲，从钢琴独奏起句，一路加厚到乐队齐鸣的高潮，动态起伏很大。
tracks.descEn: A classic 90s rock ballad that opens on solo piano and thickens all the way to a full-band climax, with a wide dynamic arc.

tracks.title: Shallow
tracks.artist: Lady Gaga & 布莱德利・古柏
tracks.desc: 对唱曲，从木吉他与清唱起句，逐步加进整个乐队，副歌处的高音是全曲情绪的顶点。
tracks.descEn: A duet that starts on bare guitar and vocal, builds in the full band, and peaks with a belted high note at the chorus.

tracks.query: Red Right Hand - Nick Cave & the Bad Seeds
tracks.title: Red Right Hand (2011 Remaster)
tracks.album: Red Right Hand (Theme from 'Peaky Blinders') - Single
tracks.desc: 阴郁的另类摇滚，钟声与风琴式的音色循环回旋，男中音近似念白的唱法，节奏刻意放得很慢。
tracks.descEn: A brooding alt-rock track built on a looping bell-and-organ motif, the baritone half-spoken vocal set against a deliberately slow tempo.

tracks.title: 分手吧
tracks.desc: 中速的民谣摇滚，编曲从吉他弹唱逐渐加厚成乐队，人声平实克制，情绪是压抑的。
tracks.descEn: A mid-tempo folk-rock song that thickens from a solo guitar-and-vocal opening into a full band, its plainspoken delivery holding the mood in check.
